title: ライバル登場、その名は……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, after the Japanese Derby, Special Week and I visit an amusement park for a change of pace.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow! Which ride should we go on first?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Or maybe we should start by eating something? I've had my eyes on that popcorn bucket for a while!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I smile as I watch Special Week excitedly struggle to make a decision, when suddenly…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Spe! Over heeere!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?! El?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's El Condor Pasa, an Umamusume gifted with the spirit of a pro wrestler and who aims to be "the world's hella strongest."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Imagine seeing you here! What a surprise!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oh! Are you here to check out the special stage wrestling event too?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? N-no, I'm just here to take a break with my trainer…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I am moved! Touched! And grateful! A new pro wrestling amigo born before my eyes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You got it all wrong! Nothing's been born here!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Don't be shy, now! C'mon, I'll guide you through this spectacular and soulful world!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El? Come now, you're making her feel uncomfortable.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yowch!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder—a refined Umamusume with a serene heart and a mighty will.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My apologies, Spe… and Spe's trainer. I'll make sure to give her a talking-to later.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: G-Grasss! I thought you were gonna pull my tail right off!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Because you were being too pushy! Honestly.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Grass! You're here with El?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Indeed. I heard that the haunted house here has a Japanese theme. It sounded quite splendid, so I had to come and take a look.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: H-haunted house? You're not scared?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe, as long as you remain calm, there's nothing to be afraid of.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wooow, you're amazing, Grass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now then, my apologies again for the ruckus. We must be going now. The event is starting soon.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I hope you both enjoy your time here!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: See ya, Grass!
choice_data_list: Your friends are quite a riot.
Your friends are quite a riot.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, they sure are!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El's a passionate pro wrestling fan, and Grass always keeps her cool. They're always energetic and fun to be around.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But that's not all they are.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: They're also really strong. When I'm racing, they're the two rivals that I respect the most!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Indeed, my image of Special Week is of a racer who's surrounded by many a formidable Umamusume.
choice_data_list: I suppose you'll race against them someday.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's right. I'm sure of it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Whoops, sorry! I got a little carried away with myself there.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Anyway, let's have a blast today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We have a fun-filled day together at the amusement park.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hm? Heya, Spe! Oh, and Spe's trainer too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey Sei! Were you out and about today too?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yup. Just doing a little bit of fishing.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: By the way, I heard you made mincemeat out of the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Which race are you aiming for next?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Next? Well…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Let me guess. Since you're aiming to be number one, maybe you're eyeing the spring Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The expression on Special Week's face changes. I can see the excitement welling up inside of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The spring Tenno Sho. It's the longest G1 race. I know how much she wants to line up on the turf alongside the best of the senior racers.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I really would like to race there!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If so, then you gotta start with the Kikuka Sho. A grueling 3,000 meters with two uphill stretches…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: But it's a race you have to experience if you're aiming for the spring Tenno Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: R-right! Uh, Trainer? I wanna run the Kikuka Sho first…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, and by the way…

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I plan on running in both the Kikuka Sho and the Tenno Sho, so I'll see ya there!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sei's gonna be… my rival?!
